ble_219_0c05a608.name: ble_link_slot_request

ble_219_0c05c320.name: ble_act_profile_apply_a
ble_219_0c05c320.summary: Select profile 1..3 from table A and restart the activity if it is running
ble_219_0c05c320.description: Maps selector byte DAT_20017046 (1, 2 or 3; other values return at once) to one of three words in table A (0x20003FBA, 0x20003FB6, 0x20003FBE) and copies it to the working word 0x200042CC and to 0x200042CA. It loads the parameter block of handle DAT_200042C7 through 0c06B64C into 0x200042C8. When the activity is idle (DAT_20017048 == 0) it fills 0x20004977 through 0c052DE8 and passes it to 0c06B6B4, sets DAT_20012ED0 = 2, and returns without starting if ble_mode_nv_is_inactive reports the NV mode off. Otherwise it starts the handle with 0c06B7BC, sets flag 0x80 with ble_flags_set on success and sets DAT_20017048 = 1. If the activity is already running it calls ble_act_set_running(0, 0, 1) and sets the pending-restart bytes DAT_20017044 and DAT_20017045 to 1. Shares its structure with ble_act_profile_apply_b.
ble_219_0c05c320.notes: Unnamed: 0c06B64C, 0c052DE8, 0c06B6B4, 0c06B7BC. The meaning of selector values 1..3 is not established.

ble_219_0c05c3e8.name: ble_act_set_running
ble_219_0c05c3e8.summary: Start (param_2 = 1) or stop (param_2 = 0) activity slot param_1 and apply pending restarts
ble_219_0c05c3e8.description: Sets DAT_20012ED0 to 2. For a start it does nothing unless ble_mode_nv_is_inactive returns 0; then it starts handle DAT_200042C7 with 0c06B7BC, sets flag 0x80 on success and marks slot param_1 running (byte 0x20017048 + param_1 = 1). For a stop it stops the handle with 0c06B818, clears flag 0x80 on success and marks the slot idle. For slot 0 with param_3 == 1 and a pending restart (DAT_20017044), it clears the pending flag and re-applies table B (ble_act_profile_apply_b) when DAT_20017045 is set, else table A. With param_3 == 0 it always re-applies table A.

params.name: param_1
params.description: activity slot index (0 is the main activity)

params.name: param_3
params.description: 1 = consume a pending restart on stop, 0 = always re-apply table A on stop

ble_219_0c05c3e8.notes: Callers include ble_act_profile_apply_a/_b and the stop path ble_act_stop. The semantic names for slot 0 and the pending flags are inferred.

ble_219_0c05c480.name: ble_act_profile_apply_b
ble_219_0c05c480.summary: Select profile 1..3 from table B and restart the activity if it is running
ble_219_0c05c480.description: Same logic as ble_act_profile_apply_a but reads table B (0x20003FB8, 0x20003FB4, 0x20003FBC) for selectors 1, 2 and 3. It uses the same handle, the same flag 0x80 and pending-restart handling, and the same ble_act_set_running(0, 0, 1) call on the running path.
ble_219_0c05c480.notes: Callers: 0c055244, 0c0555D4, 0c05C3E8, 0c05C548. Unnamed callees as in ble_act_profile_apply_a.

ble_219_0c05c548.name: ble_act_stop
ble_219_0c05c548.summary: Stop the activity, clear flag 0x80 and re-apply a queued profile if one is pending
ble_219_0c05c548.description: Sets DAT_20012ED0 to 2 and stops handle DAT_200042C7 with 0c06B818, clearing flag 0x80 when that succeeds. It then clears DAT_20017048. If a restart is pending (DAT_20017044) it clears it and re-applies table B when DAT_20017045 is set (ble_act_profile_apply_b), else table A (ble_act_profile_apply_a).

ble_219_0c05c7b6.name: ble_slot_identity_dump
ble_219_0c05c7b6.summary: Print 15 bytes of the slot identity block in hex and return 1
ble_219_0c05c7b6.description: Gets the slot header block from ble_slot_get_header_ptr (the structure before the slot table at 0x20010188) and copies 16 bytes of it to the buffer whose pointer is in r3 on entry; the decompile shows this as in_r3, not as a normal parameter. A loop then swaps bytes inside the first 8 bytes of that buffer. Bytes 0..14 are printed with %02x through 0c035D0C, followed by a constant string at 0x0C07F24C. Always returns 1.
ble_219_0c05c7b6.notes: The byte-swap pattern is hard to read from the decompile (the loop index runs over overlapping pairs), so the exact resulting byte order is uncertain. The identity meaning (BD address or serial) is not established.

ble_219_0c05c850.name: ble_link_abort_current
ble_219_0c05c850.summary: Call the handle-based abort 0c06B8BC without an explicit argument and return 0
ble_219_0c05c850.description: Calls the unnamed routine 0c06B8BC, the link-handle cancel used on the other link paths with the u16 handle in DAT_20004338, without passing an argument. The value in r0 on entry is what the callee sees. Always returns 0.
ble_219_0c05c850.notes: Callers: 0c053018, 0c0532DC, 0c053558, 0c0537B4. The missing argument is taken from the decompile as-is.

ble_219_0c05c860.name: ble_transfer_chunks_64
ble_219_0c05c860.summary: Feed param_2 bytes from param_1 to 0c065C88 in pieces of at most 64 bytes
ble_219_0c05c860.description: Loops over the buffer in chunks of up to 0x40 bytes, calling the unnamed routine 0c065C88 with each chunk's pointer and length, and advances the pointer. The remaining count is kept as a 16-bit value. A zero length returns at once. 0c065C88 works on RAM objects at 0x20011A10 and 0x20011A50 whose body is not in this packet.
ble_219_0c05c860.notes: Callers: 0c053848, 0c053A48, 0c053EE4. The 64-byte chunk size is probably a buffer or FIFO limit (not verified).

ble_219_0c05c8a8.name: ble_crypto_nv_store_blob
ble_219_0c05c8a8.summary: Store a blob in NV record 0x1389 and write the validity marker 0xEA to record 0xFAA
ble_219_0c05c8a8.description: Clears the validity flag DAT_200170CD and calls the unnamed 0c053EE4, then writes param_2 bytes from param_1 to NV record 0x1389 with ble_nv_record_write. If all bytes were written it writes the one-byte marker 0xEA to NV record 0xFAA, sets DAT_200170CD to 1, notifies through 0c055440(0x11) and returns 0. Otherwise it clears the flag, notifies with the same call and returns 0x0C.

returns.description: 0 when the blob and marker were written, 0x0C when the write fell short

ble_219_0c05c8a8.notes: The blob is probably the protected serial-number or pairing secret; record meanings are inferred. Record 0x1389 is not described in this packet.

ble_219_0c05ca80.name: ble_proto_dispatch_op
ble_219_0c05ca80.summary: Dispatch protocol sub-opcodes 0x1F and 0x20..0x29 to their handlers, always return 0
ble_219_0c05ca80.description: A switch on the sub-opcode in param_2: 0x1F calls 0c053F24 with param_6 and param_5; 0x22 calls 0c054180, 0x25 calls 0c05420C and 0x28 calls 0c0540F4 with the sub-code 9 (0x28 - 0x1F) and param_4. The group 0x20, 0x23, 0x26 and 0x29 calls the unnamed 0c065B38 with the payload pointer and 0, which releases or acknowledges it. Other values do nothing. Returns 0 on every path.

params.name: param_6
params.description: 16-bit argument passed to the 0x1F, 0x22, 0x25 and 0x28 handlers

ble_219_0c05ca80.notes: The protocol is not identified in this packet; the 0x1F..0x29 step pattern suggests message families with per-family handlers. No direct callers in the packet.
